probes.description: FORM P4-T2 (extension ladder rung 2, pack side): the labeling pack contributes functions badge(label) and areaBand(cells); ShelfLayout.nameBadge (derivedExpression `labeling::badge(name)`) and ShelfLayout.areaBandLabel (`labeling::areaBand(rows + cols)`) call them as pack::name. The call is inlined at resolve time, so the server stores and returns the EVALUATED value, never the call text; a compound argument keeps its grouping (rows + cols is summed BEFORE the body doubles it: 4 + 7 -> 22 -> 'wide', whereas an unparenthesised substitution would give 4 + 14 = 18 -> 'narrow'); both values override a lying client value and are recomputed on update.
